CustomField.description: Tracks the current IVF treatment status based on the Application Submission Date, Funding Start Date, Treatment Start Date, and funding validity rules.
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( ISBLANK(Parent.DateOfApplicationSubmission__c), Parent.DateOfApplicationSubmission__c < DATE(2026, 4, 1) ), "",
IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Treatment_Start_Date__c)), TODAY() > ADDMONTHS(Treatment_Start_Date__c, 6), TotalTreatmentandMedication__c > 0 ), "Funding Validity Exceeded",
IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Treatment_Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Treatmentstartdate__c)), Treatment_Start_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(Treatmentstartdate__c, 3) ), "Started",
IF( AND( ISBLANK(Treatment_Start_Date__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Treatmentstartdate__c)), TODAY() > ADDMONTHS(Treatmentstartdate__c, 3) ), "Not Started 3 Months Timeline Exceeded",
"Not Started" ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Treatment Status
